displayDescription: A peeled idea sticker is pressed onto a dark dot-grid surface, node stickers land and rough links connect them into a labelled system.
styleRenderer: SVG (filters: feMorphology alpha-mask dilation for white die-cut borders and contact shadows)
Rough.js 4.6.6 (seeded generator, locally bundled as rough.bundle.js)
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline (window.__timelines.video) driving plain state objects
Procedural Paper Curl and Fold Deformation (reflected fold-line clip geometry, authored in-page)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track. No soundtrack, effects or voice were created.
limitations: Paper curl is approximated as a flat fold across a moving straight line (mirrored flap in a cool backing grey with a soft shadow); no bending curvature, lighting or physical paper simulation.
Contact shadows are blurred dilated alpha masks offset by lift height, not physically lit.

PixiJS, Motion and mo.js were reviewed but not used: the scene has six stickers, so SVG is enough, and their autonomous tickers are unnecessary for seekable video. The spark burst is GSAP-owned SVG lines.
Background is a scene-dependent ink-navy dot grid chosen from BACKGROUND_REVIEW guidance; the source sampled frames are stills only, so source motion is inferred.
Typography uses locally available system fonts (Avenir Next with Trebuchet MS/Verdana fallbacks); metrics may vary slightly by machine.
